A package bundles rules, roles, skills and checks that a project can add to the template. These are the packages of release `2026-11-25` of the [package repo](https://github.com/wrufeger/act-packages); the [catalogue](https://wrufeger.github.io/act-packages/) shows the same release. The package layer (`packages.py`, `/act-packages`) is in the template from v2.7.0 on; an older project gets it with `act-update`.

| Package | Version | Contents | Tools | Contains code |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`example`](/agentic-coding-template-docs/packages/example/) | `1.0.0` | A small package to learn the format from: one rule (`R-example-greeting`), one new skill (`example-hello`) and an extension of the template's `reviewer` role. | claude-code | no |
| [`homenet`](/agentic-coding-template-docs/packages/homenet/) | `0.2.0` | Rules, roles and skills for running a home network or homelab from a project on the template: LAN and WLAN, router and network controller, hypervisor, Raspberry Pi and other servers, DNS filter, devices, firewall and Home Assistant. | claude-code | yes |

## Fetch and add

In a project on the template, list what the source offers, fetch a package and add it:

```sh
python .act/scripts/packages.py index
python .act/scripts/packages.py fetch <id>
```

then, in the assistant:

```text
/act-packages add <id>
```
